nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the Sheet UI component set, re-exporting the bits-ui Dialog root plus each sheet subcomponent under both short (Root, Content) and prefixed (Sheet, SheetContent) aliases.
nodes.languageNotes: shadcn-svelte convention: a single index.ts re-exports every part with dual naming so consumers can import either namespaced or aliased identifiers.

nodes.name: sheet.svelte
nodes.summary: Root Sheet component, a thin wrapper delegating to the bits-ui Dialog.Root primitive that manages open/close state for the slide-out panel.

nodes.name: sheet-content.svelte
nodes.summary: Main content surface of the Sheet, rendering the bits-ui Dialog content inside a portal and overlay with side-aware slide animations (top/right/bottom/left) and an optional close button.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Svelte 5 runes ($props, $bindable) and snippet rendering; side variants driven by Tailwind data-[side=*] utility classes.

nodes.name: sheet-header.svelte
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper for the Sheet header region, styling a flex column container for the title and description.

nodes.name: sheet-footer.svelte
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper for the Sheet footer region, arranging action buttons in a flex container pinned to the bottom of the panel.

nodes.name: sheet-title.svelte
nodes.summary: Accessible Sheet title, wrapping the bits-ui Dialog.Title primitive with the component's typography styling.

nodes.name: sheet-description.svelte
nodes.summary: Accessible Sheet description, wrapping the bits-ui Dialog.Description primitive with muted supporting-text styling.

nodes.name: sheet-overlay.svelte
nodes.summary: Backdrop overlay for the Sheet, wrapping the bits-ui Dialog.Overlay primitive with fade-in/out animation and a dimmed background.

nodes.name: sheet-portal.svelte
nodes.summary: Portal wrapper re-exporting the bits-ui Dialog.Portal primitive so Sheet content renders outside the normal DOM hierarchy.

nodes.name: sheet-trigger.svelte
nodes.summary: Trigger element re-exporting the bits-ui Dialog.Trigger primitive that opens the Sheet when activated.

nodes.name: sheet-close.svelte
nodes.summary: Close element re-exporting the bits-ui Dialog.Close primitive that dismisses the Sheet when activated.
